title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts — Fuel Cashback Boost for Mileage-Paid Shoppers on Card Exit
content:
## Driver cashback schedule — Everyday Pay Card exit settlements

**Clause.** In the cashback settlement made when a Cartwise Shopper Payouts account moves off the Everyday Pay Card plans, fuel cashback is boosted for shoppers who drive: a shopper with 20 or more batch mileage-pay entries in the last month has the month's fuel cashback multiplied by 1.25, a shopper with 8 to 19 has it multiplied by 1.1, and any other shopper keeps it as earned. The boosted fuel figure is rounded to the cent before the cap is applied.

**Records read.** The mileage-pay entries are the batch pay entries for mileage pay posted on the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Batches records. "The last month" counts the entries booked fewer than 1 whole month before the day of the move. The month's fuel cashback is the fuel cashback earned for the statement month the settlement carries.

| Mileage-pay entries in the last month | Fuel cashback in the settlement |
|---|---|
| 20 or more | earned fuel cashback multiplied by 1.25, rounded to the cent |
| 8 to 19 | earned fuel cashback multiplied by 1.1, rounded to the cent |
| 7 or fewer | as earned, no boost |

### Worked cases (hypothetical inputs, fuel cashback earned 9.87)

- 20 mileage-pay entries: 9.87 multiplied by 1.25 is 12.3375, rounded to the cent 12.34.
- 19 mileage-pay entries: 9.87 multiplied by 1.1 is 10.857, rounded to the cent 10.86.
- 8 mileage-pay entries: 10.86, as in the line above.
- 7 mileage-pay entries: 9.87, as earned.
